meaning.en: Outwardly harmonious and friendly; often implies avoiding conflict at the expense of principle.
meaning.zh: 形容态度和蔼，气氛融洽；也指为了和睦而不讲原则。

examples.zh: 会上大家一团和气，没人提出批评意见。
examples.en: Everyone at the meeting was all sweetness and light; no one raised any criticism.

examples.zh: 一家人一团和气，其乐融融。
examples.en: The family get on wonderfully and are very happy together.

usage.en: Predicate or object; can be critical (不讲原则).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，有时含不讲原则的贬义。

meaning.en: To treat others with complete sincerity; to confide fully.
meaning.zh: 把自己的真心放到别人的肚子里，比喻真心待人。

examples.zh: 我们推心置腹地谈了一整晚。
examples.en: We had a heart-to-heart all night.

examples.zh: 老师和他推心置腹地聊了聊，他终于说出了心里话。
examples.en: After a heart-to-heart with his teacher, he finally said what was on his mind.

story.en: Surrendered rebels said of Liu Xiu, the future Emperor Guangwu, who trusted them fully: 'He pushes his own red heart into other men's bellies — how could we not die for him?'
story.zh: 《后汉书·光武帝纪上》：“萧王推赤心置人腹中，安得不投死乎！”

usage.en: Adverbial (推心置腹地谈) or attributive.

antonyms: 黄鼠狼给鸡拜年——没安好心
害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无
黄鼠狼给鸡送礼——不怀好意

meaning.en: Without limit or end; inexhaustible.
meaning.zh: 没有止境，没有限度。

examples.zh: 群众的智慧是无穷无尽的。
examples.en: The wisdom of the people is inexhaustible.

examples.zh: 这种无穷无尽的会议让人厌烦。
examples.en: These never-ending meetings are tiresome.

meaning.en: Huge waves surging violently; also figuratively of powerful forces or trends.
meaning.zh: 大浪翻腾，水势很猛，也比喻声势浩大。

examples.zh: 台风来临，海面上波涛汹涌。
examples.en: As the typhoon arrived, the sea churned with huge waves.

examples.zh: 表面平静，暗地里却波涛汹涌。
examples.en: Calm on the surface, but turbulent underneath.

meaning.en: Blood pouring out; bleeding heavily.
meaning.zh: 血流得像灌注一样，形容出血很多。

examples.zh: 他被玻璃割伤，手上血流如注。
examples.en: He cut himself on glass and his hand was pouring with blood.

examples.zh: 伤者头部血流如注，被紧急送往医院。
examples.en: The injured man was bleeding heavily from the head and rushed to hospital.

meaning.en: To take up arms on a large scale; figuratively, to make a huge fuss or overreact over a trivial matter.
meaning.zh: 大规模地进行战争，比喻大张声势地做事或为小事闹大矛盾。

equivalents: use a sledgehammer to crack a nut

examples.zh: 为了一点小事，两家人大动干戈，闹上了法庭。
examples.en: Over a trivial matter the two families went to war and ended up in court.

examples.zh: 改个标志而已，没必要大动干戈。
examples.en: It's just changing a logo — there's no need for such a fuss.

usage.en: Predicate; often 没必要/何必大动干戈.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“何必大动干戈”。

meaning.en: Blending like water and milk; perfectly harmonious or seamlessly integrated.
meaning.zh: 像水和乳汁那样融合在一起，比喻关系密切融洽或结合得非常紧密。

examples.zh: 军民之间水乳交融。
examples.en: The army and the people are in perfect harmony.

examples.zh: 这首歌把民乐和摇滚结合得水乳交融。
examples.en: The song blends folk instruments and rock seamlessly.

meaning.en: Masses of flowers like rich brocade; a beautiful scene, or a flourishing state of affairs.
meaning.zh: 繁多的花朵像彩色的锦缎，形容美好的景色或繁荣的景象。

examples.zh: 春天的公园繁花似锦。
examples.en: In spring the park is a riot of blossom.

examples.zh: 改革开放以来，各项事业繁花似锦。
examples.en: Since reform and opening-up, every sector has flourished.

meaning.en: More people than there is work for; overstaffing.
meaning.zh: 人员多于工作，形容机构臃肿。

equivalents: too many people, not enough work

examples.zh: 这个部门人浮于事，效率很低。
examples.en: This department is overstaffed and very inefficient.

examples.zh: 精简机构就是要解决人浮于事的问题。
examples.en: Streamlining the organisation aims to tackle overstaffing.

story.en: The Record of Rites says the gentleman would rather that men exceed their salaries than salaries exceed the men (宁使人浮于食); the sense later shifted to 'people exceed the work'.
story.zh: 《礼记·坊记》：“故君子与其使食浮于人也，宁使人浮于食。”

antonyms: 一个萝卜一个坑——一个顶一个

meaning.en: To show mercy when dealing with someone; to go easy.
meaning.zh: 下手时留有情面，从宽处理。

examples.zh: 裁判，请手下留情！
examples.en: Ref, go easy on us!

examples.zh: 这孩子是初犯，请您手下留情。
examples.en: It's the boy's first offence — please be lenient.

examples.zh: 比赛中他对新手手下留情了。
examples.en: In the match he went easy on the beginner.

usage.en: Predicate; often a plea (请手下留情).

synonyms: 凡事留一线，日后好相见

meaning.en: Extremely cautious about small things, often to the point of timidity.
meaning.zh: 对细小的事情过分小心谨慎，以致畏缩。

examples.zh: 他做事谨小慎微，从不敢冒险。
examples.en: He's overcautious and never dares take a risk.

examples.zh: 新员工谨小慎微，生怕出错。
examples.en: The new employee walks on eggshells, afraid of making mistakes.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often mildly critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，多含过分小心之意。

synonyms: 战略上藐视敌人，战术上重视敌人
antonyms: 脱裤子打老虎——既不要脸，又不要命
旗杆上扎鸡毛——好大的胆（掸）子

meaning.en: To publicise something lavishly and without restraint; to hype.
meaning.zh: 毫无顾忌地大力宣传。

equivalents: go to town on the publicity

examples.zh: 商家大肆宣传这款保健品的功效。
examples.en: The merchants hyped up the supplement's benefits.

examples.zh: 这部电影上映前被大肆宣传，结果口碑一般。
examples.en: The film was heavily hyped before release but got mediocre reviews.

meaning.en: A profit as small as a fly's head; trifling gain.
meaning.zh: 像苍蝇头那样微小的利益。

examples.zh: 不要为了蝇头小利损害信誉。
examples.en: Don't damage your reputation for a petty gain.

examples.zh: 他斤斤计较蝇头小利，难成大事。
examples.en: He fusses over every trifling profit and will never achieve much.

usage.en: Object; often 贪图蝇头小利.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“贪图蝇头小利”。

pinyin: yuǎn qīn bù rú jìn lín
literal: distant · relatives · not · as-good-as · near · neighbours
natural: a good neighbour is worth more than a distant relative

meaning.en: Relatives far away are less help than neighbours close by.
meaning.zh: 住得远的亲戚不如住得近的邻居能帮忙。

equivalents: a near neighbour is better than a far-off brother

examples.zh: 远亲不如近邻，我生病时多亏邻居照顾。
examples.en: A good neighbour beats a distant relative — my neighbours looked after me when I was ill.

examples.zh: 常言道远亲不如近邻，邻里之间要互相帮助。
examples.en: As the saying goes, neighbours count more than distant kin, so we should help each other.

usage.en: Clause; often introduced by 常言道/俗话说.
usage.zh: 多单独成句，常用“俗话说”引出。

meaning.en: It is hard to cook to everyone's taste; it is impossible to satisfy everyone.
meaning.zh: 吃饭的人多，很难做出合每个人口味的饭菜，比喻做事很难让所有人都满意。

equivalents: one man's meat is another man's poison

examples.zh: 食堂的菜众口难调，总有人抱怨。
examples.en: You can't please everyone with canteen food; someone always complains.

examples.zh: 活动方案众口难调，只能少数服从多数。
examples.en: No plan satisfies everyone, so the majority decides.

meaning.en: Dizzy and disoriented; utterly confused.
meaning.zh: 头脑发晕，辨不清方向，形容头脑昏乱。

equivalents: not know whether one is coming or going

examples.zh: 一天开五个会，我忙得晕头转向。
examples.en: Five meetings in a day — I don't know whether I'm coming or going.

examples.zh: 在陌生的地铁站里，她被绕得晕头转向。
examples.en: In the unfamiliar station she was completely disoriented.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; often 忙得/搞得晕头转向.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“忙得晕头转向”。

meaning.en: To travel all over the country; to have seen much of the world.
meaning.zh: 到处奔走，经历过许多地方。

examples.zh: 他年轻时走南闯北，见多识广。
examples.en: He travelled far and wide as a young man and has seen a lot.

examples.zh: 做生意让她走南闯北，跑遍了全国。
examples.en: Business took her all over the country.

meaning.en: Impossible to reason with; utterly unreasonable.
meaning.zh: 不能用道理使他明白，形容蛮横或固执，不通情理。

examples.zh: 他简直不可理喻，跟他说什么都没用。
examples.en: He's impossible to reason with; nothing you say gets through.

examples.zh: 为了停车位吵到动手，真是不可理喻。
examples.en: Coming to blows over a parking space is simply beyond reason.

meaning.en: Different roads leading to the same destination; different methods achieving the same result.
meaning.zh: 通过不同的途径，达到同一个目的。

examples.zh: 两位科学家用不同方法得出相同结论，可谓殊途同归。
examples.en: The two scientists used different methods but reached the same conclusion.

examples.zh: 无论读书还是旅行，殊途同归，都是为了开阔眼界。
examples.en: Reading or travelling — different roads to the same goal of broadening one's horizons.

story.en: The Great Commentary on the Book of Changes: 'All under heaven come to the same end by different paths' (天下同归而殊途).
story.zh: 《周易·系辞下》：“天下同归而殊途，一致而百虑。”

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

meaning.en: To whisper to one another in low voices.
meaning.zh: 背地里小声说话。

examples.zh: 台下有几个学生在窃窃私语。
examples.en: A few students in the audience were whispering.

examples.zh: 他一进门，同事们就停止了窃窃私语。
examples.en: As soon as he walked in, his colleagues stopped whispering.

meaning.en: Unprepossessing in appearance; plain-looking (often implying hidden talent).
meaning.zh: 形容人的相貌平常或丑陋。

examples.zh: 别看他其貌不扬，却是个电脑高手。
examples.en: He may not look like much, but he's a computer whizz.

examples.zh: 这家店门面其貌不扬，菜却非常好吃。
examples.en: The shopfront is unremarkable, but the food is excellent.

synonyms: 属臭豆腐的——闻着臭，吃着香

meaning.en: Seeking capable people as eagerly as a thirsty man seeks water.
meaning.zh: 寻求贤才就像口渴想喝水一样迫切。

examples.zh: 这家公司求贤若渴，开出了很高的薪水。
examples.en: The company is hungry for talent and offering high salaries.

examples.zh: 新市长求贤若渴，广纳人才。
examples.en: The new mayor is eager to recruit capable people.

synonyms: 山不厌高，海不厌深。周公吐哺，天下归心
antonyms: 武大郎开店——比我高的不要

meaning.en: To open one's mouth like a lion; to make an exorbitant demand or ask a ridiculous price.
meaning.zh: 比喻要价很高或提出很大的要求。

examples.zh: 这个司机狮子大开口，要了三百块车费。
examples.en: The driver asked an outrageous 300 yuan for the fare.

examples.zh: 对方狮子大开口，要求赔偿一百万。
examples.en: The other side demanded a whopping million in compensation.
